theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is one of the few eligible themes combining a trend tag, above-average durability, full breadth, and no crowding. Because the validated leg is absolute-trend risk control rather than momentum alpha, this is a trend-following, vol-aware lean: if the theme remains in an uptrend, staying long GDX is more likely to avoid shake-outs than chasing the fading crowded leader. This is not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Full breadth and a clean trend can be a late-stage or participation-exhaustion signal; the detector’s cross-sectional momentum has no forward edge, and an unscheduled macro/geopolitical shock could hit risk assets broadly.

falsifier.text: GDX lags SPY by 5% or closes below its own 50-day average before the 20-trading-day check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
